component.name: metrics
component.title: Metrics
component.description: Update counters, gauges, histograms, meters and timers of a Dropwizard Metrics registry from Camel routes.
component.label: monitoring

lazyStartProducer.label: producer
lazyStartProducer.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

autowiredEnabled.label: advanced
autowiredEnabled.description: Whether autowiring is enabled. This is used for automatic autowiring options (the option must be marked as autowired) by looking up in the registry to find if there is a single instance of matching type, which then gets configured on the component. This can be used for automatic configuring JDBC data sources, JMS connection factories, AWS Clients, etc.

metricRegistry.label: advanced
metricRegistry.description: The Dropwizard MetricRegistry that holds the metrics. If not set, the component uses the bean named metricRegistry, or the only MetricRegistry bean, of the Camel registry, and else creates a registry whose Slf4jReporter logs the metrics at DEBUG level every 60 seconds.

CamelMetricsTimerAction.description: The timer action, start or stop, for the timer type. It replaces the action option.

CamelMetricsMeterMark.description: The number of events to mark on the meter, for the meter type. It replaces the mark option.

CamelMetricsHistogramValue.description: The value to add to the histogram, for the histogram type. It replaces the value option.

CamelMetricsCounterDecrement.description: The amount to subtract from the counter, for the counter type. It replaces the decrement option, and is used only when no increment is set.

CamelMetricsCounterIncrement.description: The amount to add to the counter, for the counter type. It replaces the increment option.

CamelMetricsGaugeSubject.description: The object that the gauge returns as its value, for the gauge type. It replaces the value of the gauge, or registers the gauge if it does not exist yet.

CamelMetricsName.description: The name of the metric. If not empty, it replaces the metricsName of the endpoint.

producerIn.description: Not used: the values come from the options or the CamelMetrics headers, such as CamelMetricsCounterIncrement or CamelMetricsGaugeSubject

producerOut.description: Unchanged; the CamelMetrics headers are removed

metricsType.description: The type of the metric. If the URI gives only a name, as in metrics:myName, the type is meter.

metricsName.description: The name of the metric in the MetricRegistry. A CamelMetricsName header that is not empty replaces this option.

action.description: For the timer type: start starts a timer and stores it on the exchange, and stop stops the timer that start stored on the same exchange and records the elapsed time. If no action is set, the producer logs a warning and does nothing. The CamelMetricsTimerAction header replaces this option.

decrement.description: For the counter type: the amount to subtract from the counter, used only when no increment is set by the option or the CamelMetricsCounterIncrement header. The CamelMetricsCounterDecrement header replaces this option.

increment.description: For the counter type: the amount to add to the counter. It wins over decrement, and if neither is set the counter is incremented by one. The CamelMetricsCounterIncrement header replaces this option.

mark.description: For the meter type: the number of events to mark on the meter. If not set, the meter marks one event. The CamelMetricsMeterMark header replaces this option.

subject.description: For the gauge type: the object that the gauge returns as its value, for example a bean reference. The producer registers the gauge with it when the producer starts, and the CamelMetricsGaugeSubject header replaces the value of the gauge.

value.description: For the histogram type: the value to add to the histogram. If not set, the producer logs a warning and does not update the histogram. The CamelMetricsHistogramValue header replaces this option.
